q: What if I need fewer than 20 veneers?
a: Individual veneers are $1,000 each on the price list. For 8 or 10 teeth your written estimate uses that fee; the $6,000 package is for a full set of 20.

q: Can the price go up after my exam?
a: Only if the exam finds something that must be treated first, such as a cavity or gum disease. That is quoted separately, in writing, before anything starts.
The $250 reservation deposit is applied to your treatment. If your exam shows you are not a candidate, it is refunded in full.

q: Does insurance cover any of it?
a: Veneers are cosmetic and rarely covered. Crowns and bridges often are, partly. We give you the codes to claim.
